description: The bar chart illustrates GPU memory usage for several fine-tuning approaches, including a method labeled “Ours,” with memory reported in gigabytes. The horizontal axis contains the method categories, shown as rotated labels in the order: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours; no explicit horizontal-axis label is shown. The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “GPU Memory (GB)” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 20, 40, and 60 (gridlines aligned to these ticks), with the plotted range extending to roughly the mid-70s GB. Each category is represented by a single vertical bar: Full FT is an orange bar at about 73 GB, MTL-FT is orange at about 39 GB, TAG is orange at about 21 GB, LoRA is orange at about 21 GB, QLoRA is orange at about 12 GB, and Ours is a green bar at about 21 GB. There is no legend, no stacking or grouping beyond single bars per category, and no visible annotations or special emphasis other than the distinct green color used for the “Ours” bar; the bars do not appear to be sorted by value.
